$comment: AndroidX sample FILES this catalog cannot compile, each with the reason and the evidence. A declared, CHECKED gap -- scripts/import-samples.mjs skips these and re-running the import without an entry is what says whether it is still needed -- so an exclusion cannot rot into a permanent one nobody revisits. Same contract kit-unauthorable.json carries for kit cells. Every entry below comes from a real compile failure against the pinned artifact, never from a guess ahead of one. Quarantine is per FILE, which is the unit the importer copies: a file listed here takes its whole sample set out of the catalog, including samples that would have compiled. That is a real cost, and the reason to prefer a patch wherever one is small enough to state.

samples.reason: 90 errors, all Android resources: `R.drawable.*`, `stringResource`, `painterResource`. The carousel samples draw bundled artwork, which has no desktop equivalent -- there is no resource table to resolve against. Not version skew and not fixable by a small patch; it would mean substituting different images, which would publish a picture the catalog cannot defend as AndroidX's sample.
25 errors: `android.os.Build` version gates and `LocalContext` for locale-aware formatting. The samples branch on API level, which is meaningless on the desktop renderer.
16 errors: `LocalContext`, for dynamic colour extracted from the Android system wallpaper. Dynamic colour does not exist off Android, so this sample has nothing to demonstrate here.
4 errors: `LocalConfiguration`, read to choose the 12- or 24-hour layout from the device setting. Android-only composition local.
2 errors: `androidx.core.text.isDigitsOnly`, an Android `core-ktx` extension used to validate input.
2 errors: `androidx.activity.compose.BackHandler`, which needs an Android Activity to intercept the back gesture.
2 errors: `Modifier.systemGestureExclusion`, an Android-only modifier reserving screen edges from system gestures.

2 errors: `DropdownMenuGroupLabel`, which AndroidX material3 added after the version Compose Multiplatform ships. The ONLY residual version skew once the pin was corrected to the commit matching 1.5.0-alpha22, and the one entry here expected to disappear on its own: when the CMP pin moves, samples-drift.mjs fails first and re-running the import without this entry is the check.
